title: capsicum indicum var. aviculare
intro: Capsicum indicum var. aviculare, commonly known as the 'Bird's Eye Chilli', is a variant of the Capsicum plant species. This plant has been utilized in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and preventing cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Capsicum indicum var. aviculare include analgesic, anti-edematous, and vasodilatory effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include capsaicinoids, particularly capsaicin, which is responsible for its medicinal properties and is widely used in pain management and other therapeutic applications.
